default: Welcome to ARC FARM, kid. Your grandfather was the finest farmer here.|This field has been abandoned for a long time... but the soil is still rich.
If you need seeds, see Sarah at the store. Tell her I sent you.
The villagers love being greeted. Try meeting everyone, alright.
winter: So cold this season. Wear something warm, kid.
friend: Your grandfather would love seeing that field alive again.|I honestly doubted anyone would take care of it.
If you need anything, just knock on the hall door. Do not be shy.
This village is small, but the people are kind. You have proven it.

default: Oh, a new farmer! I am Sarah, I run the village shop.|My shop is open 9 to 5. Come by!
Turnips are easiest in spring. Four days and you can harvest.
A sunny day like this is perfect for watering crops.
autumn: Autumn like this is perfect for pumpkin soup. Are you growing any?
friend: You know, I saved the best seeds just for you.|Do not tell anyone, okay.
When it is quiet, just stop by. Chatting is fine too.
My mother used to say friendly customers are a blessing. She was right.

default: A dull hoe only gives you a sore back, kid.|Bring ore to my smithy and I will make your tools sharper.
Level one tools are just warm-up. If you are serious about farming, upgrade.
Hear that hammer? That is the sound of a village still alive.
summer: The heat before the furnace in summer is... well, that is the job.
friend: I look after your tools myself when you bring them. Others wait in line.
I used to think city kids would not last here. I was wrong.
When I can no longer lift this hammer, maybe you will carry on.

default: Coffee, kid? One glass and your energy is back.|My stall is open from early morning till night.
If your energy runs out in the field, do not push it. Stop by first.
All my cooking ingredients come from the villagers' gardens. If your harvest is good, I will buy it.
winter: In winter like this, ginger tea sells fast. Want one?
friend: Your coffee is ready before you arrive. I memorized it.
This stall is lively when you stop by. No idea why.
I will cook up a new recipe later, you will be the first to try it.

default: The clinic is open every day, kid. If your energy runs out, do not force the walk home.|Just come, I will take care of it.
The thing I treat most here? Backs. Every farmer is the same.
Eat enough before heading to the field. That is the cheapest medicine I have.
winter: Many catch colds in winter. Do not sleep too late, okay.
friend: Your hands are rougher, but your face looks healthier. That is good.
I am glad someone listens when I talk about my patients.
Do not hesitate to visit even when you are not sick. I get lonely sometimes too.

default: Fifty years I have fished this bay, dear.|The sea is still the same, only I grow slower.
Good bait is not the expensive kind, but the one that waits patiently.
When the tide is low, try walking the sand. Many shells are left behind.
autumn: Autumn wind drives fish deeper. Be a little patient when fishing.
friend: Sit here, dear. Let me tell you when this bay was still full of boats.
When I can no longer sail, you look after this beach, okay.
You are patient. Patience is a fisher's greatest asset.

gift.text: Oh, your hands are empty. No rod yet, huh?|Take my old one. My hands are not as strong as they used to be, you use it.|Buy bait at Sarah's shop. Stand at the water edge, press E, then be patient a little.

default: Oh, you are the grandchild of the old farmer?|My hut is at the forest edge. Stop by if you pass, many flowers are blooming.
The wildflowers in this forest are tougher than the ones I plant myself. Funny, huh.
If you find a flower I have never seen, please bring it to me.
spring: Spring is my busiest season. The whole forest blooms at once.
friend: I saved the finest seedlings for you. Slow to grow, but worth it.
This forest feels less lively when you do not pass by.
If you stand still here a moment, the butterflies will come closer.

default: Morning! I am Billy, usually at the pier.|If you want to learn fishing, just stand next to me.
Granny Willow taught me. She says the sea dislikes hasty people.
The big fish are in deep water, at the pier end. The shore ones are small.
summer: When it is hot like this, fish rise to the surface. Try fishing in the afternoon.
friend: When we are free, let us fish together till evening. Want to?
You are the only one who can stand on the pier as long as I do.
Granny Willow says you are a more patient student than I was.

name: Bramble
role: Guardian of the woods behind the Village Hall

default: Raawwrrr
